payload.text: rhadamanth and gyges: install rustup by route C (brew install rustup, then rustup-init -y --no-modify-path; keep brew rust), last, after Intent 3.5.6 is published and each machine's batch (devbin-vc, 27 Nov). molt-vc passes devbin-vc's GO to rhadamanth-sysadm, which holds hv's yes of 26 Nov; gyges-sysadm takes its GO from devbin-vc. Each reports which -a cargo and cargo --version in a fresh login shell (hv 1 Nov rule stands).
